reachability.TS overflow skips not taken in the nativ: unreachable: those TS words store loads, constants, masks, MP, MSU or DV results, CCS results or small counts
reachability.CCS JETAG -0 (2775, 3064): refused at entry: JETAG is admitted -1..+1, the values the file stores; -0 at 2775 would fall into 3DDZ and TC Q to address 3
reachability.CCS CALFA +0/-0 at 3046: unreachable: TS A overflows only when |CALFA| exceeds cos 45
reachability.CCS Q negative at 3431: unreachable: Q is GETON1's return (3415) or ZQ's +0
reachability.TCF -2 with A = +0 in CM/DAPIC: unreachable: A = -5 + JETEM and each pass's A - 10 are never +0 in one's complement
reachability.INDEX ranges: ANGOVCOR and TRTAGXPI index with an overflow sign (+-1); the jet-code tables with dead-zone tags and ROR results (-1, +-0, +1); CA RREL with CMDAPMOD -1 (0) or ONE; CA ROLLTM and TS A with a masked bit; DXCH ENDBUF -1 and TS ENDBUF +1 with SW/NDX, admitted -13..+13
